text:
maya_prod: quick sync: new proposals for Usage list — compact stacked area inline vs donut detail flyout. Also invoice CTA placement: header vs per-row quick-preview. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/def/usage-rail-v2
sam_design: stacked area keeps row height small and matches sparklines. donut good for focused breakdown but noisy with many token types. propose toggle: inline stacked by default, donut in expanded flyout.
lee_fe: implementation note: stacked area can be pure CSS/svg with minimal rerenders. donut needs hit-testing + tooltips; more work for virtualization. also suggest fixed-width monospaced column for totals to avoid layout shift on denom toggle.
anya_a11y: accessibility: always include textual list before visuals for SRs. ensure keyboard focusable legend and aria-labels for totals (e.g., "Billable tokens: 12.3k, +4% month over month"). prefer patterns + color, not color alone.
claire_research: users want quick invoice context inline (one-line preview) and header export for full PDF. quick-preview reduced clicks in tests.
mike_pm: decision: header primary export (full), per-row quick-preview (summary) only. action: debounce full export calls and show toast with download link.
deploy-bot: Reminder: flag "usage-ui-v2" on staging deploy 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC.
sam_design: action items: I'll upload two mocks (stacked default + donut flyout) by Tue. lee to spike totals column + denom toggle, anya to draft a11y checklist, claire to add metrics to test plan.
maya_prod: great, aiming for dev spike before Wed EOD :rocket:
